context_for_next_testing_agent: Patients module fully tested. Backend API endpoints at /api/patients work correctly with CRUD operations, search, filters, pagination, and export. IGSS Units catalog at /api/igss-units works for SuperAdmin management. Frontend pages at /pacientes and /configuracion/unidades-igss are functional. Fixed bug in Pacientes.js where empty SelectItem value caused runtime error when IGSS units catalog was empty. Test file created at /app/backend/tests/test_patients.py for regression testing.
